added.description:
Overview

Continental Electronics Corporation is a leading provider of RF technologies and innovative solutions with 80 years of proven performance. CEC has experienced significant recent growth and has established itself as the go-to supplier for a diversified product line supporting a wide spectrum of markets from commercial products, military customers, to space research laboratories.

The Director of Engineering Development will lead a key portion of the engineering team responsible for electrical design, circuit design and layout, and RF front-end design for state-of-the-art RF transmitter systems. The director will guide design architecture, oversee execution from concept through release, strengthen development processes, and mentor engineers across the various programs. The role requires strong collaboration with the other engineering functions, manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and program management.

Responsibilities

Review and approve electrical designs, schematics, circuit designs, layout strategies, PCB layouts, design constraints, stack-ups, component selections, simulations, test plans, analysis results, and release documentation
Establish and maintain engineering development standards for schematic quality, circuit design practices, layout rules, component libraries, documentation, design reviews, design-for-test, and design-for-manufacturing
Pilot disciplined development reviews, including requirements reviews, architecture reviews, schematic reviews, layout reviews, design risk reviews, peer reviews, and production readiness reviews
Partner with cross-functional teams to translate customer, product, and system requirements into actionable engineering plans, trade studies, staffing needs, schedules, and deliverables
Lead, mentor, and develop a diverse team of electrical and RF engineers and designers, fostering a culture of high performance, collaboration, and continuous professional growth
Manage engineering development priorities, staffing plans, budgets, schedules, technical risks, supplier dependencies, and issue resolution across multiple programs
Develop engineering talent through coaching, mentoring, technical guidance, career development, performance feedback, and succession planning
Create functional strategies and specific objectives for the team
Develop budgets, policies and procedures to support the functional infrastructure
Spearhead talent acquisition and onboarding to scale the department as well as foster team engagement and retention
Navigate interpersonal and technical disagreements constructively to maintain a positive, healthy work environment
Uphold the company’s core values of Integrity, Innovation, Accountability, and Teamwork
Demonstrate behavior consistent with the company’s Code of Ethics and Conduct. Ensure that direct report(s) are trained and evaluated on their knowledge and adherence to the company’s values, Code of Ethics and Conduct, and applicable compliance policies
It is the responsibility of every employee to report to their manager or a member of senior management any quality problems or defects in order for corrective action to be implemented and to avoid recurrence of the problem
Duties may be modified or assigned at any time to meet the needs of the business

Qualifications

BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering or a related technical discipline or field with relevant management experience
10+ years of progressive engineering experience in electrical design, circuit design, RF engineering, PCB design, or hardware product development
Experience with RF system design, specifically high power and/or high-speed, time-based communication transmissions
Experience with tools of the trade for design, simulation, analysis and layout
A hands-on leader who is willing to dive deep as and when needed
Excellent verbal and written skills to interact with project teams, management and customers.
Demonstrate high business acumen with ability to analyze complex problems and data, and make high-quality, data-driven decisions
Proven ability to lead complex engineering development efforts, make sound technical tradeoffs, manage ambiguity, resolve risks, and deliver hardware solutions on schedule
Some travel will be required
Selected candidates must be able to obtain and maintain a Secret security clearance issued by the U.S. Government throughout the course of their employment

At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Position Summary

We're looking for a senior technology leader to own the software engineering strategy that powers CVS Health's analytics ecosystem—someone who came up through hands-on software engineering, understands what makes systems fast and reliable at the foundation, and has grown into an architect and now an engineering executive who can scale that judgment across a large organization. Lead, grow, and mentor a large engineering organization, building strong managers and senior ICs while raising the bar on engineering craft

Drive operational rigor—reliability, observability, and cost efficiency—across production data platforms supporting healthcare-critical applications
Establish engineering best practices and standards that improve speed, quality, and maintainability across teams
Communicate technical strategy and trade-offs clearly to both engineering teams and senior business stakeholders
Champion a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement

15+ years of progressive experience in Software Engineering or related technology disciplines.
7+ years of experience leading large engineering organizations through multiple layers of leadership.
Significant hands-on software engineering background, including experience architecting and delivering end-to-end data or software products
Demonstrated growth path from engineer to architect to engineering leadership, with experience managing large, multi-disciplinary teams
Strong grasp of core software engineering fundamentals—system design, performance optimization, and building simplified, maintainable solutions
Experience with cloud-based data platforms and modern engineering practices
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical rationale clearly to varied audiences

Experience in healthcare, insurance, or other regulated, high-scale industries
Background supporting AI/ML-powered products (e.g., conversational AI, summarization, search)

Familiarity with latency-sensitive, customer-facing systems at enterprise scale

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

added.description:
Blitzy is a Cambridge, MA based AI software development platform on a mission to revolutionize the software development life cycle by autonomously building custom software to unlock the next industrial revolution. We're transforming how enterprises build software, turning enterprise requirements into enterprise grade code with an agentic software development platform that can autonomously execute 80% of the quantum of software development work. We're backed by multiple tier 1 investors, and have proven success as founders of previous start-ups.

Our Culture

Who We Are

Led by two pioneering co-founders we are one of the fastest growing companies in the U.S., creating our own category of enterprise autonomous software development. We automate thousands of hours of software development for our customers, which includes strong representation within the Fortune 500.

How We Work

We move Blitzy Fast: Time is both our company’s and our clients’ most precious asset. We move quickly and decisively to innovate internally and deliver exceptional software externally.
Championship Mindset: We operate like a professional sports team. We win as a team by holding ourselves and each other to high standards, collaborating in-person, and remaining focused on the mission.
Passion for Invention: We’re pushing the frontier of what’s possible, requiring constant innovation and iteration.
We Work for the Customer: We focus on delivering outsized value to the customers we work with and expanding those relationships into deep, meaningful partnerships.
We believe in being ‘everyday athletes’: taking care of ourselves so we can bring our best minds to work. We promote great sleep, movement, and restorative activities for optimal mental performance. It makes for a happier and more productive team.

We're looking for a Head of Forward Deployed Engineering to lead and grow our embedded engineering practice across a portfolio of enterprise accounts. This is a player-coach leadership role for an experienced engineering leader who thrives in the white space between hands-on technical delivery and strategic client partnership.

You'll manage a team of Forward Deployed Software Engineers while remaining close enough to the technical work to earn credibility with customer engineering teams. You're as comfortable reviewing a pull request or debugging an integration as you are presenting a transformation roadmap to a VP of Engineering. You bring structure and accountability to delivery without sacrificing the speed and adaptability that make Blitzy different.

Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Delivery

Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Forward Deployed Software Engineers embedded across customer environments
Set standards for customer engagement, and delivery rigor across all active accounts and engineering quality
Serve as the senior technical escalation point for complex integration or delivery challenges
Balance multiple concurrent engagements, ensuring each is appropriately scoped and resourced

Customer Partnership

Own senior relationships at key accounts, engaging primarily at the VP Engineering and Director level
Participate in architecture reviews, sprint planning, and technical decision-making alongside customer teams
Lead business reviews that translate technical delivery progress into measurable business outcomes
Support pre-sales efforts for new enterprise accounts by bringing delivery credibility to the conversation

Hands-On Technical Contribution

Stay technically engaged — review code, contribute to integrations, and debug complex issues when the situation demands it
Build and maintain reusable delivery assets, integration patterns, and best practices across the team
Develop technical demos and POC frameworks that accelerate customer adoption of Blitzy's platform

Strategic & Organizational Impact

Partner with Product, Sales, and executive leadership to define the growth strategy for the FDE function
Establish delivery frameworks and feedback loops that drive continuous improvement across engagements
Contribute field intelligence that shapes product prioritization and enterprise go-to-market strategy
Contribute to thought leadership, documentation, and reusable delivery IP

Qualifications

Required Experience

Proven experience leading teams in customer-facing, embedded, or professional services engineering environments
Proven experience standing up a delivery framework from scratch
10+ years of progressive software engineering experience, including at least 3 years in a technical leadership capacity
Fluency across the modern enterprise technology stack: cloud infrastructure, APIs, microservices, CI/CD, and AI/ML integration
Demonstrated ability to manage delivery across multiple concurrent enterprise engagements
Strong communication skills — able to engage credibly from engineer to VP, adapting your style to the audience
Experience with IDEs - code-assistant tools within software development workflows

Preferred Experience

Experience at a high-growth startup or in a Forward Deployed Engineering, embedded consulting, or technical account management role
Background in AI/ML platforms, developer tooling, or enterprise software modernization
Track record of building and scaling small-to-mid-sized technical teams in outcome-driven environments
History of converting delivery excellence into account expansion and long-term partnerships
Technical thought leadership: open source contributions, conference talks, or published writing

added.description:
Do you want your voice heard and your actions to count?

Discover your opportunity with Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s leading financial groups. Across the globe, we’re 150,000 colleagues, striving to make a difference for every client, organization, and community we serve. We stand for our values, building long-term relationships, serving society, and fostering shared and sustainable growth for a better world.

With a vision to be the world’s most trusted financial group, it’s part of our culture to put people first, listen to new and diverse ideas and collaborate toward greater innovation, speed and agility. This means investing in talent, technologies, and tools that empower you to own your career.

Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded.

The selected colleague will work at an MUFG office or client sites four days per week and work remotely one day. A member of our recruitment team will provide more details.

Position Summary

MUFG is seeking a senior technology leader to help define and drive the future of AI-enabled software engineering within Business Enablement Technology
in IT Americas
. This Director-level role will lead the strategy, adoption, and organizational integration of generative AI tools across the software development lifecycle.

This is a highly visible and multifaceted leadership role for an experienced technical practitioner and transformation leader who can bridge engineering, architecture, risk, compliance, security, and business stakeholders. The successful candidate will shape how application development teams use GenAI to improve software delivery, modernize engineering practices, and evolve organizational operating models in a controlled, scalable, and enterprise-ready manner.

This role requires deep hands-on credibility in software architecture and development, strong knowledge of the rapidly evolving GenAI coding ecosystem, and the leadership presence to drive cultural and process change across a large banking technology organization.

Key Responsibilities

GenAI Strategy and Adoption

Lead the education, enablement, and adoption of GenAI tools and practices across software development teams within Business Enablement Technology.
Define and communicate a clear GenAI software engineering strategy and roadmap aligned to organizational priorities, risk standards, and delivery objectives.
Serve as the senior subject matter expert on the evolving landscape of GenAI for software development, including tooling, models, market direction, and emerging practices within financial services.

Software Development Transformation

Evolve software development practices, standards, and team workflows to incorporate and optimize the use of GenAI in the engineering lifecycle.
Identify and recommend changes to engineering processes, development governance, and delivery models to maximize the value of AI-assisted development.
Address complex questions related to AI-enabled engineering operating models, including code review approaches, team composition, developer responsibilities, productivity models, and product team interaction patterns.
Help define what enterprise-grade software delivery should look like in a future where a significant portion of code is AI-generated.

Organizational and Cultural Change Leadership

Drive cultural and organizational change required for successful adoption of GenAI development tools at scale.
Partner with technology leaders and engineering managers to build practical adoption models, capability development plans, and change management approaches.
Educate and influence both technical and non-technical stakeholders on the opportunities, limitations, and implications of GenAI-enabled software development.

Governance, Risk, Compliance, and Security Alignment

Work closely with risk, compliance, and security teams to evolve controls, standards, and oversight frameworks for AI-assisted software development and deployment.
Help define how software engineering governance must adapt as AI-generated code becomes a significant component of enterprise application delivery.
Ensure GenAI adoption approaches are aligned with the control environment and regulatory expectations of a large banking institution.

Cross-Functional Partnership and Industry Engagement

Engage with central engineering and architecture teams to represent the needs, priorities, and realities of application development teams using GenAI tools.
Collaborate with peers across application development organizations to share lessons learned, coordinate initiatives, and promote consistency where appropriate.
Monitor external industry developments, particularly within banking and financial services, and translate those developments into actionable recommendations for the organization.
Forecast and plan for future changes in the GenAI development landscape and help the organization prepare strategically and operationally.

Required Qualifications

10+ years of experience as a full-stack application architect, designer, and developer using modern languages, frameworks, and software engineering tools.
Demonstrated expertise in modern software architecture, application design, engineering practices, and enterprise software delivery.
Deep fluency with current GenAI coding tools, models, and development platforms, and a strong understanding of their practical application in enterprise software engineering.
Experience building or guiding the delivery of enterprise-grade software systems using GenAI-assisted development approaches.
Proven experience leading large-scale technical transformation and cultural change initiatives within a complex enterprise environment, preferably in a large and/or global bank.
Strong understanding of software development governance, risk management, security controls, and compliance considerations within regulated environments.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to educate, influence, and evangelize technical transformation strategies to senior technical leaders, business leaders, and control partners.
Strong executive presence, stakeholder management skills, and the ability to lead through influence across matrixed organizations.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience within financial services, banking, or another highly regulated industry.
Experience establishing or evolving engineering standards, developer platforms, or SDLC frameworks at scale.
Familiarity with secure software development, model governance considerations, and control frameworks relevant to AI-enabled engineering.
Experience working across global or multi-regional organizations.
Demonstrated ability to balance innovation, speed, quality, and control in enterprise technology environments.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is both a senior technologist and a transformation leader: someone with deep engineering credibility, strong knowledge of GenAI’s impact on software development, and the judgment to apply that knowledge in a practical, enterprise-ready way. This person should be equally comfortable advising senior executives, influencing engineering teams, and partnering with risk and control functions to shape the future of software delivery in a banking environment.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a closely-related discipline, or an equivalent combination of formal education and experience

_________________

Position Summary

The Technology Integration Director Local Media leads the technical design and execution of innovative broadcast workflows and production solutions supporting NBA and WNBA Local Media. This role is about what is both new and next, whether that be in front of the camera, on camera and in the production trucks and control rooms. Reporting to the Technology Innovation Lead, this role translates strategic content and production vision into scalable technical requirements, implementation roadmaps, and operational workflows across live event and studio environments.

Serving as a senior technical subject matter expert within Local Media, the Technical Director takes a hands-on role in designing, evaluating, testing, and implementing new broadcast technologies, infrastructure, and deployments. This individual evaluates technical feasibility, system dependencies, operational readiness, implementation risks, and cost considerations, and provides recommendations to determine how and when new production capabilities can be deployed at scale.

The role works closely with Production, Content Planning, Broadcast Strategy and the broader GPM Media Operations & Technology organization, as well as Local Media and GPM Broadcast Engineering teams, Production Operations, and external broadcast technology vendors. The Technical Director bridges production vision and technical execution, ensuring innovative concepts are translated into reliable, supportable, and cost-effective technical solutions for demanding live broadcast environments.

Major Responsibilities

Broadcast Technology Design & Implementation

Lead the technical design, architecture, and implementation of next-generation content creation, new broadcast workflows and production capabilities across Local Media broadcast environments.

We are seeking a Director of Infrastructure & Security
to own our cloud infrastructure, security program, and disaster recovery planning end to end. This is a hands-on director role for someone who can set strategy and own a budget, but is just as comfortable being in the portal, in the terminal, and — when it counts — in the code.

We run a lean, modern technology organization supporting a growing, multi-site business. Our cloud estate, our corporate offices, and every one of our locations depend on infrastructure that is fast, available, and defensible. You will be the person who can say, with evidence, “here is our risk posture, here is what we are doing about it, and here is how long it would take us to recover.”

You will lead a dedicated, long-tenured nearshore pod rather than a rotating bench — real leadership without a large org chart, where your judgment is spent on architecture, risk, and sequencing rather than managing layers.

Key Responsibilities

Cloud Infrastructure

Own the architecture, cost, performance, and reliability of our cloud estate — primarily Azure, Entra ID, Microsoft 365, and Intune, with workloads and vendor dependencies touching AWS and GCP.
Drive infrastructure-as-code and repeatable deployments, reducing the number of things that exist only because someone clicked a button once.
Own cloud cost management: visibility, accountability by workload, and a credible plan to bend the curve.
Set the standards for networking, identity, secrets management, and environment separation.

Security

Own the security program across identity, endpoint, network, application, and data — for cloud workloads and for our physical office and site environments: segmentation, wireless, physical access systems, on-site hardware.
Run vulnerability and patch management, endpoint protection, email security, logging and SIEM, and alert triage through to closure.
Own third-party and vendor risk review, including inbound security questionnaires and partner security reviews.
Build and maintain the policy set — access control, acceptable use, data handling, incident response — and make it something people actually follow.
Lead security awareness: phishing simulation, onboarding and offboarding controls, and least-privilege enforcement that survives contact with real work.
Map our controls to the data protection obligations that apply to us — PII, PHI, and state and international privacy regimes — and close the gaps.

Disaster Recovery and Resilience

Own business continuity and disaster recovery planning. Define RTO and RPO per system with the business, then design to those numbers.
Test it: backup restores, failover drills, and tabletop exercises on a published cadence — not a binder nobody has opened.
Own incident response end to end: detection, escalation, communication to leadership, and blameless post-incident review.

Hands-On Engineering

Read and write code. When production is degraded and the application team is stretched or asleep, be comfortable opening the repository, getting oriented quickly with AI coding tools (we use Claude Code), and shipping either a safe fix or a credible mitigation.
Automate your own work: scripting, pipelines, runbooks as code, and monitoring you built and understand rather than monitoring you bought and forgot.

Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team.

Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers.

The Role

We are hiring a Head of Technology Partnerships to build the external relationships that make the Telnyx platform stronger, faster, and harder to replicate. This role reports to the CEO and Head of Product and is based in San Francisco or New York City.

This is not a partner marketing role and it is not a channel sales role. You will work directly with Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, Sales, and executive leadership to identify the technology companies Telnyx should work with, define what the partnership should actually unlock, negotiate it, and get it into production.

The scope is broad by design. One week you may be working with a GPU or semiconductor partner on capacity and roadmap access. The next you may be structuring a relationship with a model provider, cloud platform, carrier, network operator, data center, AI framework, or enterprise technology platform. The job is to find the relationships where combining Telnyx infrastructure with another company's technology creates a material advantage for customers or for Telnyx.

The best partnerships here should produce something tangible: better economics, lower latency, new product capability, preferred access to capacity, deeper product integration, distribution, or revenue.

Responsibilities

Own Telnyx's technology partnership strategy across AI infrastructure, model providers, hardware, cloud, networking, telecom, data center, developer platforms, and adjacent ecosystems.
Identify and prioritize a small number of partnerships where Telnyx can create a differentiated technical or commercial position.
Build senior relationships with partners across product, engineering, business development, and executive teams.
Translate partnership ideas into concrete technical and commercial plans with clear owners, milestones, economics, and success metrics.
Work directly with Telnyx Product and Engineering teams to scope integrations, joint product capabilities, capacity agreements, and roadmap dependencies.
Negotiate commercial terms, technical commitments, capacity, pricing, co-development, distribution, and go-to-market structures where relevant.
Drive partnerships from first conversation through signed agreement, integration, launch, and measurable adoption.
Create leverage for enterprise sales by turning strategic technology relationships into capabilities, reference architectures, and joint solutions that matter to customers.
Track the market aggressively. Know which model providers, inference stacks, GPU platforms, networking technologies, agent frameworks, and communications platforms are gaining traction and why.
Kill weak partnerships early. We care about shipped capability and economic value, not the number of logos on a slide.

What We Are Looking For

10+ years in technology partnerships, business development, product strategy, infrastructure, enterprise technology, or a similarly technical role.
Strong technical fluency. You do not need to be a software engineer, but you should be comfortable discussing APIs, inference, GPUs, networking, telecom, cloud architecture, latency, capacity, and production integrations with engineering teams.
A track record of getting complex partnerships from idea to signed agreement and then into production.
Strong commercial judgment. You can model the value of a partnership, understand where leverage sits, and negotiate accordingly.
Ability to operate across very different counterparties, from hyperscalers and semiconductor companies to startups, carriers, and infrastructure providers.
Comfort working directly with senior executives while still going deep with product and engineering teams.
High ownership and low bureaucracy. You should be comfortable starting with an ambiguous objective and turning it into a shipped result.
Clear, concise communication. You can explain why a partnership matters in a page, not a deck of 40 slides.

Bonus Points

Experience in AI infrastructure, GPU cloud, inference, telecommunications, networking, CPaaS, developer platforms, or edge compute.
Existing relationships with companies such as NVIDIA, AMD, cloud providers, model labs, AI infrastructure companies, carriers, data centers, or major developer platforms.
Experience negotiating capacity, compute, network, or infrastructure agreements in addition to traditional software partnerships.
Experience launching joint technical products or integrations with measurable usage and revenue.
Experience working in a high-growth company where the product and market are changing quickly.

Why This Role Matters

Telnyx owns more of the stack than most companies in our category. That gives us unusual flexibility, but it also means the right external technology relationships can compound quickly.

A strong partnership can improve our unit economics, accelerate a roadmap, secure scarce infrastructure, open a new distribution path, or create a product that neither company could offer alone. This role exists to find those opportunities and turn them into operating reality.

We are not looking for someone to manage an ecosystem. We are looking for someone to build strategic advantage through it.
